item.title: Lantern Night Date and Venue

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical promo for our Lantern Night, with glowing lanterns after dark. Put the date and venue big on screen so people know when and where to come. No voiceover.

item.tests: Checks that missing event details are requested and then rendered accurately as readable text in the finished promo.

answer_sheet.Event title and exact wording: Lantern Night; 14 November 2026; Willow Park, Bristol
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm glowing lanterns outdoors after dark; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: English text, no voiceover. Music or silence is your call.

must_haves: The delivered video is 8 seconds long and vertical 9:16.
'14 November 2026' and 'Willow Park, Bristol' appear clearly on screen together for at least 3 seconds.
Warm glowing lanterns are visible against an after-dark setting.

turns.text: Could you make a promo for our Lantern Night? I’m excited about the event and a little worried that the promo won’t get across how lovely it feels in person. What I’m after is an 8-second video in a vertical format. It should show glowing lanterns after dark. Please put the date and venue big on screen so people know when and where to come. I don’t want any voiceover.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—I’ll aim for a warm, magical feel, with glowing lanterns after dark and large, easy-to-read event details in an **8-second vertical video**, with **no voiceover**.

What **date** and **venue name** should appear on screen?
dialog.why: It asks for the date and venue name to display and waits for the user’s information.
dialog.user: The date is 14 November 2026, and the venue is Willow Park, Bristol—please use those exact words on screen. The event title is simply “Lantern Night.” I’m excited about it, and I’m just hoping the warm glow captures a little of how lovely it feels in person.

The planned version is **8 seconds, vertical and silent**, with warm lanterns glowing after dark and these exact words large on screen:

**Lantern Night**  
**14 November 2026**  
**Willow Park, Bristol**

Once enough credits are available, I can retry those same settings.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical 9:16 event promo. After dark in a beautiful park, many glowing amber paper lanterns hang safely among tree branches and above a winding garden path. Warm golden pools of light, deep blue night sky, delicate bokeh, welcoming intimate atmosphere, cinematic photorealism. A single slow gentle forward camera glide, stable coherent scene, no cuts, capture the quiet beauty and warmth of experiencing lantern night in person. No speech, no voiceover, no audio. CRITICAL: Display large sharp highly legible static typography throughout the full clip, centered in safe margins, ivory lettering against uncluttered deep navy negative space with subtle dark backing. Exact text, preserving spelling and punctuation, arranged in three clear blocks: top title 'Lantern Night'; prominent middle-lower date '14 November 2026'; prominent bottom venue 'Willow Park, Bristol'. Make date and venue big and easy to read on a phone; venue may wrap onto two lines without changing any words or punctuation. Keep all three text blocks visible for all 8 seconds, without morphing, changing spelling, extra words or logos. Lantern glow surrounds the text without obscuring it.
